messages.text: What if the name and address are from a news article?
The article mentions a named business and its office address; we should not assume every address in a news report is public business contact data.

For the reviewed article, the address belongs to a named business rather than a private residence. If it were an individual’s location, it would require separate PII review. A publicly listed company address and a personal residence raise different questions.
